section_summary.extract_value: This procedure section describes a study conducted in Greater London, United Kingdom, where participants were recruited opportunistically from public locations and completed a paper-and-pencil survey. The study obtained ethics approval, used semi-randomized scale presentation with demographics last, and participants provided written informed consent without remuneration. No explicit study numbering is mentioned, and demographic and outcome data are not provided in this section.
